definitions.explanation: An uncultivated, desolate area with little vegetation.

examples.japanese: {荒野|こうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To travel alone through the wilderness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広大|こうだい}な→広大：11328_koudai⟧{荒野|こうや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。

notes:
{荒野|こうや} describes desolate, uncultivated wilderness or wasteland.

WRITING:
{荒|こう} (wild, rough) + {野|や} (field, plain)

ALTERNATE READINGS:
- こうや (most common)
- あらの (literary)
- あれの (archaic)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{広大|こうだい}な→広大：11328_koudai⟧{荒野|こうや}: vast wilderness
- {荒野|こうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel through the wilderness
- {荒野|こうや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: flowers bloom in the wasteland

METAPHORICAL USE:
Used figuratively to describe emotional desolation or a difficult, lonely situation.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧: desert
- ⟦{原野|げんや}→原野：11979_genya⟧: wilderness, plains
- ⟦{荒|あ}れ{地|ち}→荒れ地：20128_arechi⟧: wasteland
